What to do if your flight was canceled by Southwest Airlines ✈️

🚨 The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is expected to reduce flight capacity by 10% at 40 major airports across the country starting Friday should the government shutdown continue, including at Texas' busiest airports. 

🛬 Within that order, all airlines have been directed to reduce flight schedules on Friday, including Dallas-based Southwest Airlines, who shared some helpful tips for any travelers facing headaches.
